```{r Calculate Interaction Diversity}

tdat_interaction <- tdat %>% select(X,DispoCode, Genus, Agapornis_swindernianus:Zosterops_senegalensis) %>% pivot_longer(names_to = "Animal", values_to = "InteractionProbability", cols = Agapornis_swindernianus:Zosterops_senegalensis)

tdat_interaction2 <- tdat_interaction %>% filter(InteractionProbability ==1) %>% unite("Interaction", Genus:Animal, sep="_")

#Richness
div_values_interaction <- tdat_interaction2 %>%select(DispoCode, Interaction) %>%group_by(DispoCode) %>% summarise(richness = length(unique(Interaction))) 

#Alpha Diversity
tdat3_interaction <- tdat_interaction2%>% group_by(DispoCode, Interaction) %>% summarise(InteractionProbability = sum(InteractionProbability)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Interaction, values_from = InteractionProbability)
tdat3_interaction[is.na(tdat3_interaction)]<-0
tdat3_interaction<- as.data.frame(tdat3_interaction)
rownames(tdat3_interaction)<- tdat3_interaction$DispoCode
tdat3_interaction <- tdat3_interaction[,-1]
diversity_values_interaction <- vegan::diversity(tdat3_interaction)#calculate alpha diversity values
div_values_interaction$alpha <- diversity_values_interaction

#Beta Diversity
beta_div_interaction <- beta.div(tdat3_interaction, "hellinger", nperm=1000) #calculate beta diversity
beta_values_interaction <- beta_div_interaction$LCBD# calculate local contributions to beta diversity
div_values_interaction$beta <- beta_values_interaction

#Proportion of trees with frugivore interaction

prop_dat2 <- left_join(tdat_interaction, animal_taxa[,c(2,4)], by = "Animal") %>% dplyr::select(DispoCode, InteractionProbability, Taxa,X) %>% group_by(DispoCode, X, Taxa) %>% summarise(Interaction = sum(InteractionProbability)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Taxa, values_from = Interaction) %>% dplyr::select(-X)
prop_dat2 <- prop_dat2[,-1]
prop_dat2$Ape[prop_dat2$Ape>0]<-1
prop_dat2$Bat[prop_dat2$Bat>0]<-1
prop_dat2$Bird[prop_dat2$Bird>0]<-1
prop_dat2$BushBaby[prop_dat2$BushBaby>0]<-1
prop_dat2$Carnivore[prop_dat2$Carnivore>0]<-1
prop_dat2$Elephant[prop_dat2$Elephant>0]<-1
prop_dat2$Monkey[prop_dat2$Monkey>0]<-1
prop_dat2$Rodent[prop_dat2$Rodent>0]<-1
prop_dat2$Suidae[prop_dat2$Suidae>0] <- 1
prop_dat2$Ungulate[prop_dat2$Ungulate>0]<-1
prop_dat2$Total <- prop_dat2$Ape + prop_dat2$Bat +prop_dat2$Bird +prop_dat2$BushBaby + prop_dat2$Carnivore +prop_dat2$Elephant +prop_dat2$Monkey +prop_dat2$Rodent+prop_dat2$Suidae+prop_dat2$Ungulate
prop_dat2$Total[prop_dat2$Total>0] <- 1

prop_dat3 <- prop_dat2 %>% group_by(DispoCode) %>% summarise(Abundance = n(),
                                                             Ape = sum(Ape),
                                                             Bat = sum(Bat),
                                                             Bird = sum(Bird),
                                                             BushBaby = sum(BushBaby),
                                                             Carnivore= sum(Carnivore),
                                                             Elephant = sum(Elephant),
                                                             Monkey = sum(Monkey),
                                                             Rodent = sum(Rodent),
                                                             Suidae = sum(Suidae),
                                                             Ungulate = sum(Ungulate),
                                                             NDisp = sum(Total),
                                                             ApeProp = Ape/Abundance,
                                                             BatProp = Bat/Abundance,
                                                            BirdProp = Bird/Abundance,
                                                             BushBabyProp = BushBaby/Abundance,
                                                             CarnivoreProp = Carnivore/Abundance,
                                                             ElephantProp = Elephant/Abundance,
                                                             MonkeyProp = Monkey/Abundance,
                                                             RodentProp = Rodent/Abundance,
                                                             SuidaeProp = Suidae/Abundance,
                                                             UngulateProp = Ungulate/Abundance,
                                                             Prop_disp = NDisp/Abundance)

richness_threshold <- div_values_interaction$richness
alpha_threshold <- div_values_interaction$alpha
beta_threshold <- div_values_interaction$beta
prop_threshold <- prop_dat3$Prop_disp
n_threshold <- prop_dat3$NDisp
ape_threshold <- prop_dat3$Ape
ape_prop_threshold <- prop_dat3$ApeProp
bat_threshold <- prop_dat3$Bat
bat_prop_threshold <- prop_dat3$BatProp
bird_threshold <- prop_dat3$Bird
bird_prop_threshold <- prop_dat3$BirdProp
bush_threshold <- prop_dat3$BushBaby
bush_prop_threshold <- prop_dat3$BushBabyProp
carnivore_threshold <- prop_dat3$Carnivore
carnivore_prop_threshold <- prop_dat3$CarnivoreProp
elephant_threshold <- prop_dat3$Elephant
elephant_prop_threshold <- prop_dat3$ElephantProp
monkey_threshold <- prop_dat3$Monkey
monkey_prop_threshold <- prop_dat3$MonkeyProp
rodent_threshold <- prop_dat3$Rodent
rodent_prop_threshold <- prop_dat3$RodentProp
suidae_threshold <- prop_dat3$Suidae
suidae_prop_threshold <- prop_dat3$SuidaeProp
ungulate_threshold <- prop_dat3$Ungulate
ungulate_prop_threshold <- prop_dat3$UngulateProp


interaction_threshold <- data.frame(div_values_interaction$DispoCode, richness_threshold, alpha_threshold, beta_threshold, prop_threshold, n_threshold,
       ape_threshold, bat_threshold, bird_threshold, bush_threshold, carnivore_threshold, elephant_threshold, monkey_threshold, rodent_threshold, suidae_threshold, ungulate_threshold,
     ape_prop_threshold, bat_prop_threshold, bird_prop_threshold, bush_prop_threshold, carnivore_prop_threshold, elephant_prop_threshold, monkey_prop_threshold, rodent_prop_threshold, suidae_prop_threshold, ungulate_prop_threshold)

colnames(interaction_threshold) <- c("DispoCode", "richness", "alpha", "beta", "prop", "n", "ape", "bat", "bird", "bush", "carnivore", "elephant", "monkey", "rodent", "suidae", "ungulate", "ape_prop", "bat_prop", "bird_prop", "bush_prop", "carnivore_prop", "elephant_prop", "monkey_prop", "rodent_prop", "suidae_prop", "ungulate_prop")
```

```{r}
library(spatialreg)

interaction_threshold2 <- metadata  %>% left_join(interaction_threshold, by ="DispoCode") %>% filter(DispoCode %in% div_meta_interaction$DispoCode)
interaction_threshold2$Succ2[interaction_threshold2$Succ2=="Prm"] <- "aPrm"

richness_sar <- errorTemprichness_sar <- errorsarlm(richness ~ Elephant + VillDist + Temp + Succ2 + Prec +Latitude + SoilPCA + NightLights + PopDensity,
                      data = interaction_threshold2,
                      listw = lw)
richness_sar_summary <- summary(richness_sar)

alpha_sar <- errorsarlm(alpha ~ Elephant + VillDist + Temp + Succ2 + Prec +
                        Latitude + SoilPCA + NightLights + PopDensity,
                      data = interaction_threshold2,
                      listw = lw)
alpha_sar_summary <-summary(alpha_sar)

beta_sar <- errorsarlm(beta ~ Elephant + VillDist + Temp + Succ2 + Prec +
                        Latitude + SoilPCA + NightLights + PopDensity,
                      data = interaction_threshold2,
                      listw = lw)
beta_sar_summary <-summary(beta_sar)

n_sar <- errorsarlm(n ~ Elephant + VillDist + Temp + Succ2 + Prec +
                        Latitude + SoilPCA + NightLights + PopDensity,
                      data = interaction_threshold2,
                      listw = lw)
n_sar_summary <-summary(n_sar)


library(mgcv)

interaction_threshold2$n_round <- round(interaction_threshold2$n,0)
interaction_threshold2$n_opp <- interaction_threshold2$abundance -interaction_threshold2$n_round 

gam_binom <- gam(
  cbind(n_round, n_opp) ~ Elephant + VillDist + Temp + Succ2 + Prec +
   SoilPCA + NightLights + PopDensity +
    s(Longitude, Latitude, bs = "tp"),          # spatial smooth
  data = interaction_threshold2,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  method = "REML"
)

binom_sar_summary <-summary(gam_binom)

library(broom)

binom_sar_summary <- tidy(gam_binom, parametric = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") 

```

```{r Interaction Diversity Plots}

richness_df_interaction <- as.data.frame(richness_sar_summary$Coef)
richness_df_interaction$Variable <- rownames(richness_df_interaction)
richness_df_interaction$Type <- "Richness"

alpha_df_interaction <- as.data.frame(alpha_sar_summary$Coef)
alpha_df_interaction$Variable <- rownames(alpha_df_interaction)
alpha_df_interaction$Type <- "Alpha Diversity"

beta_df_interaction <- as.data.frame(beta_sar_summary$Coef)
beta_df_interaction$Variable <- rownames(beta_df_interaction)
beta_df_interaction$Type <- "Beta Diversity"

proportion_df_interaction <- as.data.frame(binom_sar_summary)
proportion_df_interaction$Variable <- proportion_df_interaction$term
proportion_df_interaction$Type <- "Proportion Dispersed"
proportion_df_interaction <- proportion_df_interaction[,-1]
colnames(proportion_df_interaction) <- colnames(beta_df_interaction)

n_df_interaction <- as.data.frame(n_sar_summary$Coef)
n_df_interaction$Variable <- rownames(n_df_interaction)
n_df_interaction$Type <- "Abundance Dispersed"

taxonomic_div_interaction <- rbind(richness_df_interaction, alpha_df_interaction, beta_df_interaction, proportion_df_interaction, n_df_interaction)
taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable[taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable=="Elephant1"]<- "Ele. Act."
taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable[taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable=="Elephant"]<- "Ele. Act."
taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable[taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable=="VillDist"]<- "Vill. Dist."
taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable[taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable=="Elev"]<- "Elev."
taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable[taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable=="Latitude"]<- "Lat."
taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable[taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable=="Succ2Sec"]<- "Secondary"
taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable[taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable=="Succ2Exp"]<- "Logged"
taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable[taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable=="Temp"]<- "Temp."
taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable[taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable=="Prec"]<- "Prec."
taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable[taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable=="SoilPCA"]<- "Soil PCA"
taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable[taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable=="SoilPCA"]<- "Soil PCA"
taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable[taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable=="NightLights"]<- "Night Lights"
taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable[taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable=="PopDensity"]<- "Pop. Density"

taxonomic_div_interaction$Lower <- taxonomic_div_interaction$Estimate - 1.96 * taxonomic_div_interaction$`Std. Error`
taxonomic_div_interaction$Upper <- taxonomic_div_interaction$Estimate + 1.96 * taxonomic_div_interaction$`Std. Error`
taxonomic_div_interaction$Lower90 <- taxonomic_div_interaction$Estimate - 1.644854 * taxonomic_div_interaction$`Std. Error`
taxonomic_div_interaction$Upper90 <- taxonomic_div_interaction$Estimate + 1.644854 * taxonomic_div_interaction$`Std. Error`

taxonomic_div_interaction <- taxonomic_div_interaction %>% filter(Variable != "(Intercept)")

taxonomic_div_interaction$VarType <- taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable
taxonomic_div_interaction$VarType[taxonomic_div_interaction$VarType=="Ele. Act."] <- "Environmental"
taxonomic_div_interaction$VarType[taxonomic_div_interaction$VarType=="Lat."] <- "Environmental"
taxonomic_div_interaction$VarType[taxonomic_div_interaction$VarType=="Elev."] <- "Environmental"
taxonomic_div_interaction$VarType[taxonomic_div_interaction$VarType=="Temp."] <- "Environmental"

taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable <- factor(taxonomic_div_interaction$Variable, levels = c("Ele. Act.", "Temp.","Prec.", "Elev.", "Lat.", "Soil PCA", "Vill. Dist.", "Secondary", "Logged", "Night Lights", "Pop. Density"))

richness_plot_interaction <- ggplot(data=taxonomic_div_interaction[taxonomic_div_interaction$Type=="Richness",], aes(x= Variable, y= Estimate, ymin=Lower, ymax=Upper, color=VarType))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype="dashed")+
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(0.5), size=0.7, lwd=0.7)+
  geom_linerange(aes(x= Variable, y= Estimate, ymin=Lower90, ymax=Upper90), position = position_dodge(0.5), linewidth=1.5)+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("Estimated Effect on Richness")+
  theme(legend.position="bottom")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("gold", "darkblue"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
  labs(color='Variable Type')
```

```{r Evolutionary Distinctiveness of Ineractions}

beta_div <- beta.div(tdat3, "hellinger", nperm=1000) #calculate beta diversity
beta_values <- beta_div$LCBD# calculate local contributions to beta diversity
div_values$beta <- beta_values

#Plants
gcbd <- data.frame(beta_div$SCBD)
gcbd$Genus <- rownames(gcbd)
colnames(gcbd)[1] <- "gcbd"

plants <- gcbd %>% select(Genus)
plants <- getTaxonomy(plants$Genus)
colnames(plants) <- c("genus", "family")
plants$species <- plants$genus
plants$spp <- "sp"
plants <- unite(data=plants, "species", species, spp, sep = " ")
plants <- plants%>% select(species, genus, family)
y <- V.PhyloMaker::phylo.maker(plants, scenarios = "S3") # default scenario
tree_plants <- y$scenario.3
plot(tree_plants)

#EDi = EDm + EDp

ED_plants <- evol.distinct(tree_plants, type ="equal.splits", scale = FALSE, use.branch.lengths = TRUE)
ED_plants <- ED_plants %>% separate(Species, c("Genus", "sp"), sep = "_") %>% select(-sp) %>% rename(w_plants =w)
ED_animals <- evol.distinct(frug_tree, type ="equal.splits", scale = FALSE, use.branch.lengths = TRUE)
colnames(ED_animals)<- c("Animal", "w_animals")
ED_animals$Animal[ED_animals$Animal=="Loxodonta_africana"] <- "Loxodonta_cyclotis"
ED_animals$Animal[ED_animals$Animal=="Galagoides_demidovii"] <- "Galagoides_demidoff"
#ED_animals$Animal[ED_animals$Animal=="Loxodonta_africana"] <- "Loxodonta_cyclotis"
ED_animals <- as.data.frame(ED_animals)

tdat_interaction <- tdat2 %>% select(DispoCode, Genus, Agapornis_swindernianus:Zosterops_senegalensis) %>% pivot_longer(names_to = "Animal", values_to = "InteractionProbability", cols = Agapornis_swindernianus:Zosterops_senegalensis)


tdat_interaction <- left_join(tdat_interaction, ED_plants, by = "Genus")
tdat_interaction <- left_join(tdat_interaction, ED_animals, by = "Animal")
  
tdat_interaction2 <- tdat_interaction %>% filter(InteractionProbability ==1) %>% unite("Interaction", Genus:Animal, sep="_") %>% drop_na(w_animals)

tdat_interaction2$EDi <- tdat_interaction2$w_plants + tdat_interaction2$w_animals

EDi <- tdat_interaction2$EDi
DispoCode <- tdat_interaction2$DispoCode



#Evolutionary Distinctiveness of interactions
EDi_df <- data.frame(EDi, DispoCode)
colnames(EDi_df)<- c("EDi", "DispoCode")
EDi_df2 <- tdat_interaction2%>%drop_na() %>% group_by(DispoCode) %>% summarise(Mean_EDi = mean(EDi))
div_meta_interaction2 <- div_meta_interaction2 %>% left_join(EDi_df2, by ="DispoCode")


edi_sar <- errorsarlm(Mean_EDi.x ~ Elephant + VillDist + Temp + Succ2 + Prec +
                        Latitude + SoilPCA + NightLights + PopDensity,
                      data = div_meta_interaction2,
                      listw = lw)

edi_sar_summary <-summary(edi_sar)


edi_mod_summary <- as.data.frame(edi_sar_summary$Coef)

edi_mod_summary$Lower <- edi_mod_summary$Estimate - 1.96 * edi_mod_summary$`Std. Error`
edi_mod_summary$Upper <- edi_mod_summary$Estimate + 1.96 * edi_mod_summary$`Std. Error`
edi_mod_summary$Lower90 <- edi_mod_summary$Estimate - 1.644854 * edi_mod_summary$`Std. Error`
edi_mod_summary$Upper90 <- edi_mod_summary$Estimate + 1.644854 * edi_mod_summary$`Std. Error`

edi_mod_summary$Variable <- rownames(edi_mod_summary)
edi_mod_summary$Variable[edi_mod_summary$Variable=="Prec"] <- "Prec."
edi_mod_summary$Variable[edi_mod_summary$Variable=="SoilPCA"] <- "Soil PCA"
edi_mod_summary$Variable[edi_mod_summary$Variable=="VillDist"] <- "Vill. Dist."
edi_mod_summary$Variable[edi_mod_summary$Variable=="Temp"] <- "Temp."
edi_mod_summary$Variable[edi_mod_summary$Variable=="Elephant1"] <- "Ele. Act."
edi_mod_summary$Variable[edi_mod_summary$Variable=="Latitude"] <- "Lat."
edi_mod_summary$Variable[edi_mod_summary$Variable=="Succ2Sec"] <- "Secondary"
edi_mod_summary$Variable[edi_mod_summary$Variable=="Succ2Exp"] <- "Logged"
edi_mod_summary$Variable[edi_mod_summary$Variable=="PopDensity"] <- "Pop. Density"
edi_mod_summary$Variable[edi_mod_summary$Variable=="NightLights"] <- "Night Lights"

edi_mod_summary$VarType <- edi_mod_summary$Variable
edi_mod_summary$VarType[edi_mod_summary$VarType=="Ele. Act."] <- "Environmental"
edi_mod_summary$VarType[edi_mod_summary$VarType=="Lat."] <- "Environmental"
edi_mod_summary$VarType[edi_mod_summary$VarType=="Elev."] <- "Environmental"
edi_mod_summary$VarType[edi_mod_summary$VarType=="Temp."] <- "Environmental"
edi_mod_summary$VarType[edi_mod_summary$VarType=="Soil PCA"] <- "Environmental"
edi_mod_summary$VarType[edi_mod_summary$VarType=="Prec."] <- "Environmental"
edi_mod_summary$VarType[edi_mod_summary$VarType=="Vill. Dist."] <- "Anthropogenic"
edi_mod_summary$VarType[edi_mod_summary$VarType=="Logged"] <- "Anthropogenic"
edi_mod_summary$VarType[edi_mod_summary$VarType=="Secondary"] <- "Anthropogenic"
edi_mod_summary$VarType[edi_mod_summary$VarType=="Pop. Density"] <- "Anthropogenic"
edi_mod_summary$VarType[edi_mod_summary$VarType=="Night Lights"] <- "Anthropogenic"

edi_mod_summary2 <- edi_mod_summary %>% filter(Variable != "(Intercept)")

edi_mod_summary2$Variable <- factor(edi_mod_summary2$Variable, levels = c("Ele. Act.", "Temp.","Prec.",  "Lat.", "Soil PCA", "Vill. Dist.", "Secondary", "Logged", "Night Lights", "Pop. Density"))

edi_plot <- ggplot(data=edi_mod_summary2, aes(x= Variable, y= Estimate, ymin=Lower, ymax=Upper, color=VarType))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype="dashed")+
  geom_pointrange(aes(color=VarType),position = position_dodge(0.5), size=0.7, lwd=0.7)+
  geom_linerange(aes(x= Variable, y= Estimate, ymin=Lower90, ymax=Upper90, color=VarType), position = position_dodge(0.5), linewidth=1.5)+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("Estimated Effect on ED")+
  theme(legend.position="bottom")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("gold", "darkblue"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
    labs(color='Variable Type') 


diversity_plot_interaction2 <- ggarrange(richness_plot_interaction, alpha_plot_interaction, beta_plot_interaction,edi_plot, labels = c("a", "b", "c", "d"), nrow=2,ncol=2, common.legend = TRUE)


write.csv(edi_mod_summary2, "edi_mod_summary2_thershold.csv")
write.csv(taxonomic_div_interaction, "taxonomic_div_interaction_threshold.csv")
```
